explication: Jesse is a self-hosted crypto strategy framework: users define Python strategies, then run backtests and research, optimize parameters, and deploy in paper/live trading. The main runtime spans API controllers, strategy and simulation modes, exchange/order handling, and session results; candles feed both simulation and live market views. Separate branches provide candle import/export, statistical significance and Monte Carlo analysis, ML, charts, and MCP access. The graph uses README capabilities and the supplied tree; most subsystem wiring beyond sampled controller, service, and repository excerpts is intentionally left unspecified.
